items.abstract_or_text: People assume that in an AI doing formal verification world, they can take their existing codebase, ask AI to prove it correct, and get either a proof or a bug. Sadly reality has a few bones to pick with this, and one of them is the "existing codebase" part. And that's due to the good ol' halting problem. The short of it is that there is no general purpose algorithm that takes any program and input and correctly determines whether it will terminate or run forever. With a few mathematical flourishes we can extend that to "Rice's theorem" and prove this is true for any nontrivial semantic property, meaning we can't automatically prove arbitrary things about arbitrary programs. Now obviously we can prove some things about some programs, or else formal verification wouldn't exist as a field. The trick is that we write the code in a style suitable for verification. One example of this is totality: in Lean, all functions must be guaranteed to return a value for all inputs. If we want some code that runs forever (like f.ex a server), instead of `while true` we do `while (i < 10^60)` so that it's guaranteed to terminate and return a value (after the end of the universe). (Totality is also why, in Lean, `1/0 == 0`. If you convert your code to Lean without accounting for this, you could have correct lean but incorrect code!) Another "style" we use is state machines. Even if your code doesn't quite fit an SM architecture, if you want to prove it at scale, you're probably going to go with a state machine. State machines are the carcinisation of provable code. Hopefully by now the problem is clearer: even if your codebase is objectively correct, it might not be in the right shape to be proven correct! Okay, just have the AI rewrite your codebase into another form, right? Two problems. One: you don't know if you've introduced errors in the rewrite because you can't prove them equivalent (since one of them is not in a provable shape). Two: making code more verifiable can make it worse on other metrics, like modifiability, performance, and complexity. And now you've got the old bugbear of software engineers, the dreaded tradeoff. Now, don't get me wrong, formal verification has a huge role in the future of software, but it's not going to be a breezy "prove my Ruby thx" Claude prompt. It's still going to take work and expertise on our parts to prove our code, and to strike the right balance between formal verification and other forms of correctness. This is one reason I'm so excited to be working at @AntithesisHQ , which tackles a lot of the same properties as proof methods, but verifies them with "deterministic simulation testing" and fuzzing instead of with a proofs. So it's not as thorough and doesn't give you confidence in all inputs, but it automatically works on pretty much any code shape. I've literally grabbed open source projects off Github, told Claude "check properties XYZ in Antithesis thx", and gotten bug reports back. No state machine rewrites needed.
items.summary_zh: Hillel 解释：不能把任意现有代码库直接交给 AI 就得到形式化正确性证明；停机问题和 Rice 定理限制了自动证明，代码通常需要改写为适合验证的形式，而这会与可维护性、性能和复杂度产生权衡。他还分享了在 Antithesis 中用确定性模拟测试和模糊测试检查开源项目的经验。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是关于 AI 辅助形式化验证边界的具体工程分析，并给出了可复现的替代实践。编辑判断：作者同时讨论可证明性、代码重写风险和测试工具适用范围，明显超出“AI 能自动证明代码”的口号。
items.abstract_zh: 人们以为，在 AI 进行形式化验证的世界里，可以把现有代码库交给 AI，让它证明代码正确；结果要么得到证明，要么发现一个 bug。遗憾的是，现实在“现有代码库”这一点上就会提出问题，其中一个原因是众所周知的停机问题。简而言之，不存在一种通用算法，能够对任意程序和输入都正确判断程序最终会终止还是会无限运行。加上一些数学推演，我们可以用 Rice 定理扩展这一结论：对于任意非平凡的语义性质，都不可能自动证明任意程序的任意性质，因此我们无法自动证明任意代码的任意性质。当然，我们能够证明某些程序的某些性质，否则形式化验证就不会成为一个领域。关键在于，我们会以适合验证的风格编写代码。例如全性：在 Lean 中，所有函数都必须保证对所有输入返回一个值。如果想编写会无限运行的代码（例如服务器），就不能写 while true，而要写成 while (i < 10^60)，这样它在理论上保证会终止并返回一个值（即使要等到宇宙终结之后）。全性也是 Lean 中 1/0 == 0 的原因。如果不考虑这一点就把代码转换到 Lean，可能得到形式上正确但实际错误的 Lean 代码。我们采用的另一种“风格”是状态机。即使代码并不完全适合状态机架构，如果想在规模上证明它，通常也会采用状态机。状态机几乎成了可证明代码的普遍形态。现在问题应该更清楚了：即使代码库客观上正确，也可能不具备适合证明的结构。那就让 AI 把代码库重写成另一种形式，行不行？有两个问题。第一，由于原代码不具备可证明结构，你无法证明重写前后的代码等价，因此也不知道重写过程中是否引入了错误。第二，让代码更容易验证，可能会损害可修改性、性能和复杂度等其他指标，于是又回到了软件工程师熟悉的权衡。形式化验证当然会在软件未来发挥巨大作用，但它不会是一次轻松的“证明我的 Ruby 代码，谢谢”式 Claude 提示词。证明代码仍然需要我们的工作和专业能力，还要在形式化验证与其他正确性标准之间取得平衡。这也是我很期待在 Antithesis 工作的原因之一：它处理许多与证明方法相同的性质，但使用确定性模拟测试和模糊测试，而不是证明。它不如证明彻底，也不能让你对所有输入都有信心，但基本可以自动处理各种代码结构。我确实从 GitHub 上拿过开源项目，告诉 Claude“请在 Antithesis 中检查这些性质”，然后得到过 bug 报告，不需要先把代码重写成状态机。

items.abstract_or_text: We're expanding our approach to content provenance to include text in response to EU regulatory requirements, while recognizing the significant limitations of current text watermarking technology. Our tools already help verify whether an image or audio file was created with our models. This work builds on those efforts to help people better understand when content may have been generated or edited with an OpenAI model. In the EU, we’ll start watermarking eligible text from ChatGPT and Codex over the coming weeks to comply with the EU AI Act. Customers using our API can turn on text watermarking for select models worldwide today.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 表示将把内容来源追踪扩展到文本：未来几周在欧盟为符合条件的 ChatGPT 和 Codex 文本启用水印，API 用户目前可在全球范围为部分模型开启文本水印。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是官方对文本来源标记落地范围、时间和限制的直接说明。编辑判断：它同时涉及 EU AI Act 合规与模型输出可追溯性，对开发者和研究者都有实际影响。
items.abstract_zh: 我们正在扩大内容来源追踪的方法，将文本纳入其中，以回应欧盟监管要求，同时也认识到当前文本水印技术存在显著局限。我们的工具已经能够帮助核验图像或音频文件是否由我们的模型生成。这项工作是在这些努力基础上的延伸，旨在帮助人们更好地了解内容何时可能由 OpenAI 模型生成或编辑。在欧盟，我们将在未来几周开始为 ChatGPT 和 Codex 生成的符合条件的文本添加水印，以遵守《欧盟人工智能法案》。使用我们 API 的客户目前可以在全球范围为部分模型开启文本水印。

items.title: Assessing the state of the art in ADMET prediction: Lessons from the OpenADMET-ExpansionRx community blind challenge
items.abstract_or_text: Computational blind challenges are essential for advancing drug discovery, especially in research areas with limited public data, such as absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, toxicity (ADMET) prediction. In this paper, we present the results of our latest community blind challenge, organized in collaboration with Expansion Therapeutics (ExpansionRx). Participants were tasked with predicting nine distinct ADMET endpoints routinely evaluated during lead optimization of compounds in drug discovery programs. Following unprecedented engagement from the global community, this challenge provided valuable insights into the state of the art in machine learning for ADMET modeling. Evaluating submissions against a realistic, challenging dataset from active ExpansionRx drug discovery programs revealed that message-passing neural networks and chemical foundation models dominated among the top performers. Furthermore, the results highlighted the power of proprietary industry datasets and a critical need to optimize predictive workflows for different endpoints independently via multitasking and task-affinity grouping. We also demonstrate how hosting our open-source blind challenge infrastructure on a flexible platform like Hugging Face was pivotal for driving community engagement and visibility. Ultimately, blind challenges supported by robust infrastructure, widespread dissemination, and rigorous post-challenge analysis are fundamental to maximizing the utility of public data releases. We anticipate that these community benchmarks will continue to drive the advancement of ADMET models, enabling their deployment in both early- and late-stage drug discovery.
items.summary_zh: 总结 OpenADMET-ExpansionRx 社区盲测：在 9 个 ADMET 终点上，消息传递神经网络和化学基础模型位居前列，并揭示按终点独立优化工作流的必要性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 真实药物发现项目数据上的公开盲测为 ADMET 模型提供了更接近实际应用的比较基准，也强调了专有工业数据和任务亲和分组的重要性。限制是挑战结果依赖特定数据集和参赛方案，不能直接代表所有 ADMET 场景。
items.abstract_zh: 计算盲测对于推进药物发现至关重要，尤其是在 ADMET 预测等公开数据有限的研究领域。在本文中，我们介绍最近一次与 Expansion Therapeutics（ExpansionRx）合作组织的社区盲测结果。参赛者需要预测药物发现项目先导优化阶段常规评估的 9 个不同 ADMET 终点。在全球社区前所未有的参与度推动下，这次挑战为机器学习 ADMET 建模的最新水平提供了有价值的洞见。将提交结果在来自 ExpansionRx 正在进行的药物发现项目、真实且具有挑战性的数据集上进行评估后发现，消息传递神经网络和化学基础模型在顶尖方案中占主导地位。此外，结果凸显了专有工业数据集的力量，以及通过多任务学习和任务亲和分组针对不同终点独立优化预测工作流的关键需求。我们还展示了，将开放源代码的盲测基础设施部署在 Hugging Face 等灵活平台上，对于提升社区参与度和可见度具有决定性作用。归根结底，拥有稳健基础设施、广泛传播和严格赛后分析的盲测，对于最大化公开数据发布的效用至关重要。我们预计，这类社区基准将继续推动 ADMET 模型发展，使其能够部署到药物发现的早期和后期阶段。

items.title: Generating Structural Ensembles of Disordered Proteins with Diffusion Models
items.abstract_or_text: Generative models of protein structures have accelerated scientific discovery. However, the leading structure-prediction models are trained primarily on crystal structures, limiting their ability to sample the conformations of intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs). All-atom molecular dynamics (MD) simulations can probe the diversity of IDP conformational ensembles, but these simulations are slow and costly. Leveraging the speed of generative models and the accuracy of MD, we develop Zephyr, an SE(3) equivariant diffusion model trained on simulated IDP ensembles. The model generates the structure of a single protein sequence in two phases: a coarse-grained structure is first sampled and heavy atoms are subsequently denoised onto this structure. We evaluate our method on two fronts: ensemble accuracy and sampling efficiency. Across five test systems, the model reproduces key geometric and energetic metrics of the MD ensembles, while sampling at least 63 times faster.
items.summary_zh: 开发 SE(3) 等变扩散模型 Zephyr，在模拟的 IDP 构象集合上训练，以两阶段生成单条蛋白质序列的结构集合。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 针对晶体结构训练模型难以覆盖 intrinsically disordered proteins 的问题，Zephyr 在五个测试体系上复现 MD 几何和能量指标，并至少提升 63 倍采样速度。摘要未说明与更多实验数据或更广泛蛋白家族的验证。
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质结构生成模型已加速科学发现。然而，领先的结构预测模型主要在晶体结构上训练，这限制了它们对内在无序蛋白（IDP）构象进行采样的能力。全原子分子动力学（MD）模拟可以探测 IDP 构象集合的多样性，但这类模拟缓慢且成本高昂。我们利用生成模型的速度和 MD 的准确性，开发了 Zephyr——一种在模拟的 IDP 构象集合上训练的 SE(3) 等变扩散模型。该模型分两个阶段生成单条蛋白质序列的结构：首先采样粗粒化结构，随后在该结构上对重原子进行去噪。我们从两个方面评估该方法：集合准确性和采样效率。在五个测试体系中，该模型复现了 MD 构象集合的关键几何和能量指标，同时采样速度至少快 63 倍。

items.title: Iterative computational bioprospecting of hydroxymethylfurfural oxidases combining molecular simulation and machine learning
items.abstract_or_text: The enzymatic oxidation of 5-hydroxymethylfurfural (HMF) to 2,5-furandicarboxylic acid (FDCA) is a key step in the sustainable production of polyethylene furanoate (PEF), yet the final oxidation of 5-formyl-2-furancarboxylic acid (FFCA) to FDCA remains the principal bottleneck for industrial application. Although hydroxymethylfurfural oxidases (HMFOs) can catalyze this transformation, naturally occurring enzymes with high FFCA-oxidizing activity remain largely unexplored. Here, we present an iterative computational bioprospecting campaign to identify natural HMFOs with improved activity toward this rate-limiting reaction. Across four successive rounds, the computational workflow evolved from conservative homology-based screening to large-scale sequence mining assisted by machine learning, with each iteration redesigned according to the principal limitations identified through molecular simulations and experimental characterization. This adaptive strategy led to the discovery of several natural HMFOs with substantially improved FFCA oxidation activity, including candidates whose performance under the tested conditions approached that of the engineered benchmark 8BxHMFO. Beyond the identification of promising biocatalysts, the study demonstrates the value of continuous integration of computational prediction and experimental feedback for refining enzyme discovery campaigns, and provides practical insights into balancing catalytic prioritization, sequence diversity, developability, and computational scalability in future simulation-guided bioprospecting efforts.
items.summary_zh: 研究以分子模拟、机器学习和实验反馈构成迭代式计算生物勘探流程，筛选天然 HMFO，并发现多个对 FFCA 氧化活性显著提高的候选酶。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把序列挖掘、分子模拟与实验表征闭环结合，且候选性能在测试条件下接近工程化基准 8BxHMFO，对可持续 FDCA 生物制造有直接价值。局限是摘要未给出具体活性数值、底物范围和放大条件。
items.abstract_zh: 5-羟甲基糠醛（HMF）酶促氧化为 2,5-呋喃二甲酸（FDCA）是可持续生产聚呋喃二甲酸乙二醇酯（PEF）的关键步骤，但 5-甲酰基-2-呋喃甲酸（FFCA）向 FDCA 的最终氧化仍是工业应用的主要瓶颈。尽管羟甲基糠醛氧化酶（HMFO）能够催化这一转化，但天然存在且具有高 FFCA 氧化活性的酶仍未得到充分探索。我们在此提出一项迭代式计算生物勘探工作，以寻找对这一限速反应具有更高活性的天然 HMFO。在连续四轮筛选中，计算流程从保守的基于同源性的筛选发展到机器学习辅助的大规模序列挖掘；每一轮都根据分子模拟和实验表征发现的主要局限重新设计。这一自适应策略发现了若干 FFCA 氧化活性显著提高的天然 HMFO，其中一些候选在测试条件下的表现接近工程化基准 8BxHMFO。除了鉴定有前景的生物催化剂外，本研究还展示了持续整合计算预测与实验反馈对于改进酶发现方案的价值，并为未来由模拟引导的生物勘探中如何平衡催化活性优先级、序列多样性、可开发性和计算可扩展性提供了实践见解。

items.title: A Stereochemical Blueprint for Thermoresponsive Polymers
items.abstract_or_text: Predicting polymer structure-property relationships is challenging due to the vast chemical expanse of polymer design space and the limited availability of high-quality datasets that effectively span the design space. Here, we present a physics-informed framework that integrates high-throughput molecular dynamics (MD) simulations with machine learning to predict the lower critical solution temperature (LCST) of stereochemically diverse poly(Nisopropylacrylamide) (PNIPAM) systems using 5632 MD simulation trajectories, corresponding to a cumulative simulation time of 2816 µs. We use validated MD simulations to generate descriptors that capture local hydration and conformational environments, enabling the extraction of molecular features directly linked to thermoresponsive behaviour. The resulting model accurately reproduces subtle experimentally observed LCST variations arising from changes in tacticity, demonstrating that sequence derived features and simulation-derived hydration descriptors encode the molecular information required to resolve compositiondependent phase behaviour. Beyond LCST prediction, the framework provides mechanistic insight into the molecular origins of thermoresponsive behaviour of PNIPAM, revealing that meso and racemic dyads undergo distinct backbone rotational mediated collapse pathways, with meso dyads requiring backbone rotation through partially hydrated intermediates, whereas racemic dyads collapse within a fixed backbone rotational conformation through closure of the isopropyl-isopropyl distance. These findings establish a transferable simulation-machinelearning strategy for linking polymer structural information to macroscopic properties and accelerating the discovery of functional polymer materials.
items.summary_zh: 基于 5632 条分子动力学轨迹和机器学习，预测不同立构规整度 PNIPAM 的 LCST，并解析 meso 与 racemic 二联体的不同塌缩路径。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将模拟衍生水合描述符与序列特征连接到宏观热响应性质，既有可迁移的材料筛选框架，也给出立体化学影响 LCST 的机制解释。限制是模型依赖经验证的 MD 和有限的 PNIPAM 体系，外推到其他聚合物仍需检验。
items.abstract_zh: 由于聚合物设计空间的化学范围极其广阔，且能够有效覆盖该设计空间的高质量数据集有限，预测聚合物结构–性质关系具有挑战性。在此，我们提出一个受物理学启发的框架，将高通量分子动力学（MD）模拟与机器学习相结合，利用 5632 条 MD 模拟轨迹（累计模拟时间为 2816 μs）预测立体化学多样的聚（N-异丙基丙烯酰胺）（PNIPAM）体系的最低临界溶解温度（LCST）。我们使用经过验证的 MD 模拟生成能够捕捉局部水合和构象环境的描述符，从而提取与热响应行为直接相关的分子特征。所得模型准确再现了由立构规整度变化引起的实验观察到的细微 LCST 变化，表明序列衍生特征和模拟衍生水合描述符编码了分辨依赖组成的相行为所需的分子信息。除 LCST 预测外，该框架还为 PNIPAM 热响应行为的分子起源提供了机制洞见，揭示 meso 和 racemic 二联体经历不同的主链旋转介导塌缩路径：meso 二联体需要主链旋转经过部分水合的中间态，而 racemic 二联体则在固定的主链旋转构象内通过异丙基–异丙基距离闭合而塌缩。这些发现建立了一种可迁移的模拟–机器学习策略，用于将聚合物结构信息与宏观性质联系起来，并加速功能聚合物材料的发现。
items.author_line: Rangika Munaweera, Martin Stroet, Megan L. O'Mara

items.title: Solving density-of-states occupation in disordered systems using neural networks
items.abstract_or_text: Describing density-of-states occupation with high precision in disordered systems is crucial for modeling charge transport and understanding doping mechanisms or interfacial energy-level alignment. Beyond fundamental insight from a mechanistic understanding of these physical phenomena, accurate modeling is pivotal for optimizing technological applications in optoelectronic and thermoelectric devices. However, the required calculations are computationally demanding and inherently complex, preventing systematic computational-experimental approaches. Here, we leverage neural networks to perform these calculations precisely and efficiently. We first demonstrate this approach for the Fermi-Dirac occupation of Gaussian densities of states, achieving accelerations of up to three orders of magnitude, a substantial advantage for advanced modeling workflows that require repeated evaluation of the underlying integrals. We then introduce a neural network for doped molecular materials, such as organic semiconductors, that directly predicts doping levels and Fermi level shifts, circumventing conventional recursive schemes and accelerating computations by nearly five orders of magnitude.
items.summary_zh: 用神经网络近似无序体系的态密度占据计算，在高斯态密度上实现最高三个数量级加速，并直接预测掺杂分子材料的掺杂水平和费米能级位移。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把反复求解费米–狄拉克积分和递归掺杂计算转化为快速代理模型，对有机半导体及光电、热电器件建模有实际计算价值。摘要未提供独立实验验证或跨材料体系的泛化结果。
items.abstract_zh: 高精度描述无序体系中的态密度占据，对于模拟电荷输运、理解掺杂机制或界面能级对齐至关重要。除了从这些物理现象的机制理解中获得基础洞见外，准确建模对于优化光电和热电器件等技术应用也十分关键。然而，所需计算在计算上代价高昂且本质复杂，使系统性的计算–实验研究难以开展。在此，我们利用神经网络精确而高效地执行这些计算。我们首先针对高斯态密度中的费米–狄拉克占据展示了这一方法，实现最高三个数量级的加速；对于需要重复评估底层积分的高级建模工作流，这是一个显著优势。随后，我们为掺杂分子材料（如有机半导体）引入一个神经网络，直接预测掺杂水平和费米能级位移，从而绕过传统递归方案，使计算加速近五个数量级。
items.author_line: Melissa Berteau-Rainville, Emanuele Orgiu, Ingo Salzmann

items.title: Consecutive hydrodefluorination for the regioselective synthesis of partially fluorinated arenes
items.abstract_or_text: Fluorinated arenes are critically important motifs in drug discovery, often exhibiting superior bioactivity compared to their non-fluorinated counterparts. While advances in fluorination methods have improved access to monofluoroarenes, the synthesis of di- and trifluoroarenes remains challenging. Here, we present a powerful method for access to partially fluorinated arenes via consecutive hydrodefluorination of perfluoroarenes, executed in one ‘pot’. This method utilises hydridosilicates as the reducing species, which are formed in situ by the combination of phenylsilane and cesium carbonate in dimethylsulfoxide. These conditions avoid precious metal catalysts and exotic reagents, exhibiting exceptional regioselectivity and control over the degree of defluorination. Through an in-depth mechanistic study, we found that hydridosilicates can perform hydrodefluorination by two distinct mechanisms, one thermal and one photochemical. These mechanisms are complementary in substrate scope—together, they enable a method with notable generality.
items.summary_zh: 提出以原位生成的 hydridosilicate 为还原物种的连续氢解氟方法，在一锅中区域选择性合成部分氟化芳烃，并通过机理研究区分热反应和光化学反应路径。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 为药物发现中重要的二氟、三氟芳烃片段提供避免贵金属催化剂和特殊试剂的合成路线，且区域选择性和脱氟程度可控。摘要未给出底物数量、收率范围和放大稳定性。
items.abstract_zh: 氟化芳烃是药物发现中的关键结构单元，与未氟化对应物相比通常表现出更优的生物活性。尽管氟化方法的进展改善了单氟芳烃的获取，但二氟和三氟芳烃的合成仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们提出一种通过全氟芳烃连续氢解氟、在一锅中获得部分氟化芳烃的有效方法。该方法使用氢硅酸盐作为还原物种；氢硅酸盐由 phenylsilane 与 cesium carbonate 在 dimethylsulfoxide 中组合原位生成。这些条件避免使用贵金属催化剂和特殊试剂，同时表现出很高的区域选择性，并能控制脱氟程度。通过深入的机理研究，我们发现氢硅酸盐可以通过两种不同机制进行氢解氟，其中一种是热机制，另一种是光化学机制。这两种机制在底物范围上具有互补性，共同赋予该方法显著的普适性。
items.author_line: Yanxian Tan, Howard Toh, Chieh-Yu Chang, Phillip S. Grant

items.title: Extraction of clinical information from faxed medical records using a small local large language model pipeline on consumer hardware
items.abstract_or_text: Objective Specialty referral packets often arrive by fax and clinicians must manually read and organize a large amount of disparate information to affect continuity of care. Commercial large language models (LLMs) can organize packet information, but protected health information (PHI) must be secured. We evaluated whether an open-weight pipeline running entirely on one consumer graphics card can accurately extract clinical information from faxed referral packets. Materials and Methods We generated 200 synthetic colorectal cancer referral packets from simulated patient records, rendered them as faxes without a text layer. A local pipeline transcribed each packet with an optical character recognition model (OvisOCR2) and extracted structured data with an open-weight LLM (Qwen3.8 27B). Twenty outcomes spanning patient identifiers, laboratory results, dates, diagnoses, procedures, medications, imaging, and event chronology were scored against ground truth on 140 validation packets. Results Laboratory values were extracted exactly in 98.9% of 7879 instances, dates in 99.7%, diagnoses in 100%, and procedures in 92.9%. Timeline recall was 96.7% and precision 99.4%. Weighted accuracy was 0.990 (95% CI 0.987 - 0.992). None of 11,993 extracted facts were fabricated. Median processing time was 90 seconds per packet. Conclusion An open-weight pipeline on consumer hardware accurately extracted multi-domain clinical information from synthetic faxed referrals.
items.summary_zh: 在单张消费级 GPU 上运行 OCR 与 Qwen3.8 27B 的本地管线，从无文本层传真转诊包中提取结构化临床信息。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在合成数据上实现高准确率且未发现事实幻觉，说明本地部署可作为隐私敏感场景的可复现基线，但尚需真实临床资料验证。
items.abstract_zh: 目的：专科转诊资料包经常通过传真到达，临床医生必须手动阅读并整理大量分散信息，以维持医疗连续性。商业大语言模型可以组织资料包信息，但必须保护受保护健康信息（PHI）。我们评估了一个完全在一张消费级显卡上运行的开放权重管线，能否准确提取传真转诊资料包中的临床信息。材料与方法：我们根据模拟患者记录生成了 200 份合成结直肠癌转诊资料包，并将其渲染为没有文本层的传真。一个本地管线先用 OCR 模型 OvisOCR2 转录每份资料包，再用开放权重 LLM Qwen3.8 27B 提取结构化数据。我们在 140 份验证资料包上，以真实值为标准，对涉及患者标识符、实验室结果、日期、诊断、操作、药物、影像和事件时间线的 20 项结局进行评分。结果：在 7879 个实例中，实验室数值的精确提取率为 98.9%，日期为 99.7%，诊断为 100%，操作为 92.9%。时间线召回率为 96.7%，精确率为 99.4%。加权准确率为 0.990（95% CI 0.987–0.992）。提取的 11,993 条事实中没有一条被捏造。每份资料包的处理时间中位数为 90 秒。结论：在合成传真转诊资料上，运行于消费级硬件的开放权重管线能够准确提取多领域临床信息。
items.author_line: Tang, Z.

items.title: Machine Learning-Accelerated Inverse Design of Sequence-Controlled Terpolymers
items.abstract_or_text: Sequence-controlled polymers hold immense potential for advanced materials design, yet discovering their experimental recipes is bottlenecked by the high-dimension kinetic parameter space of multicomponent copolymerization. Traditional ordinary differential equation (ODE) solvers provide rapid macrokinetic predictions but are fundamentally blind to explicit backbone microstructures. To bridge this gap, we use a stochastic simulation algorithm (SSA) engine to generate high-throughput terpolymer sequence data from a physically constrained parametric sweep across a 9-dimensional kinetic space, charting how feed stoichiometry and kinetic propensities dictate macromolecular structure. Information-theoretic analysis and t-SNE dimensionality reduction of the resulting 27-component triad frequency matrices for each simulation reveal profound microstructural degeneracies, demonstrating that traditional ensemble descriptors, such as the Harwood run number, are fundamentally incapable of describing sequence specifics. To accelerate optimization, we establish a digital twin strategy utilizing an XGBoost regressor to instantaneously predict localized chain-end propagation probabilities based on target sequence motifs. Finally, we demonstrate a closed-loop inverse design strategy that passes the 2 machine learning predictions to a deterministic root-finding optimizer, isolating exact initial monomer feeds and reactivity ratios needed to create them. By training an ML surrogate using explicit chain sequences from SSA, this framework provides a powerful alternative to classical macrokinetic equations, establishing an immediate, predictive tool to accelerate the discovery and reliable synthesis of sequence-controlled functional macromolecules.
items.summary_zh: 用受物理约束的随机模拟算法生成序列可控三元共聚物数据，再以 XGBoost 数字孪生和确定性求根优化器反推单体进料与反应性比，实现闭环逆向设计。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 方法显式建模链序列，弥补传统 ODE 宏观动力学看不到微观结构的缺陷，并将高维动力学参数搜索转化为可计算的逆设计流程。摘要主要展示模拟和模型结果，尚缺合成实验的独立验证。
items.abstract_zh: 序列可控聚合物对先进材料设计具有巨大潜力，但多组分共聚合中高维动力学参数空间使实验配方的发现成为瓶颈。传统常微分方程（ODE）求解器能够快速进行宏观动力学预测，却从根本上无法观察显式的主链微观结构。为弥合这一差距，我们使用随机模拟算法（SSA）引擎，在受物理约束的 9 维动力学空间中进行参数扫描，高通量生成三元聚合物序列数据，从而描绘进料化学计量和动力学倾向如何决定大分子结构。对每次模拟得到的 27 分量三联体频率矩阵进行信息论分析和 t-SNE 降维，结果显示出显著的微观结构简并性，说明 Harwood 成环数等传统总体描述符根本无法描述具体序列。为加速优化，我们建立了数字孪生策略，利用 XGBoost 回归器根据目标序列基序即时预测局部链端传播概率。最后，我们展示了一种闭环逆向设计策略，将 2 个机器学习预测传递给确定性求根优化器，从而确定生成这些目标所需的初始单体进料和反应性比。通过使用 SSA 生成的显式链序列训练机器学习替代模型，该框架为经典宏观动力学方程提供了有力替代方案，建立了可立即用于预测的工具，以加速序列可控功能大分子的发现和可靠合成。
items.author_line: Jeffrey C. Foster

items.title: Integrating Developmental Neurotoxicity Prediction with Adverse Outcome Pathway Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Experimental assessment of developmental neurotoxicity (DNT) is costly, time-consuming, and difficult to scale across large chemical inventories. New approach methodologies (NAMs), including computational approaches based on machine learning, deep learning, and large language models (LLMs), offer new ways to screen and prioritize chemicals. However, these emerging computational approaches have largely focused on predicting toxicity endpoints, with less attention to the mechanisms underlying those predictions. For DNT assessment, understanding this mechanistic basis is equally important. In this study, we integrated LLM inference with the adverse outcome pathway (AOP) framework to connect DNT predictions with plausible mechanisms. We constructed an AOP-informed benchmark linking ChEMBL target-activity measurements for 5,861 compounds to 14 AOPs representing five neurodevelopmental outcomes and evaluated ten LLMs for the prediction of molecular initiating events (MIEs), key events (KEs), key event relationships (KERs), and adverse outcomes (AOs), as well as the generation of mechanistic explanations. Explanation quality was evaluated using both a naive LLM judge and a rubric-based LLM judge. Across the zero-shot models, the highest observed macro-F1 scores were 0.818 for MIEs and 0.463 for AOs, but only 0.056 for KEs and 0.034 for KERs, identifying downstream pathway reconstruction as the principal challenge. Few-shot prompting substantially improved performance, with Gemini 3.8 Flash under four-shot prompting achieving macro-F1 scores of 0.956 for AOs, 0.813 for MIEs, 0.492 for KEs, and 0.457 for KERs. Both LLM-judge configurations indicated improved mechanistic explanation quality with few-shot examples, although strong outcome prediction did not consistently ensure recovery of the recorded pathway. Our results demonstrate the potential of AOP-informed LLMs to support DNT assessment by linking predicted neurodevelopmental outcomes to plausible biological mechanisms and enabling predictions to be evaluated at both the outcome and pathway levels.
items.summary_zh: 构建连接 ChEMBL 活性数据与 14 条 AOP 的 DNT 基准，评估 10 个 LLM 对 MIE、KE、KER 和 AO 的预测及机制解释能力。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把毒性终点预测推进到不良结局通路层面，并量化显示 few-shot 对通路重建的帮助。限制是 zero-shot 下 KE/KER 表现很弱，且较好的 AO 预测并不保证恢复真实通路。
items.abstract_zh: 发育神经毒性（DNT）的实验评估成本高、耗时长，而且难以扩展到大规模化学品清单。包括基于机器学习、深度学习和大语言模型（LLM）的计算方法在内的新方法学（NAM）为化学品筛查和优先级排序提供了新途径。然而，这些新兴计算方法主要聚焦于毒性终点预测，而较少关注支撑预测的机制。对于 DNT 评估，理解其机制基础同样重要。在本研究中，我们将 LLM 推理与不良结局通路（AOP）框架结合起来，把 DNT 预测与合理的机制联系起来。我们构建了一个受 AOP 启发的基准，将 5861 个化合物的 ChEMBL 靶点活性测量与代表五类神经发育结局的 14 条 AOP 关联起来，并评估了 10 个 LLM 对分子起始事件（MIE）、关键事件（KE）、关键事件关系（KER）和不良结局（AO）的预测能力，以及生成机制解释的能力。解释质量同时由朴素 LLM 评审器和基于评分标准的 LLM 评审器进行评价。在 zero-shot 模型中，观察到的最高宏平均 F1 分数在 MIE 上为 0.818，在 AO 上为 0.463，但在 KE 上仅为 0.056，在 KER 上仅为 0.034，表明下游通路重建是主要挑战。Few-shot 提示显著提高了性能；在 four-shot 提示下，Gemini 3.8 Flash 对 AO、MIE、KE 和 KER 的宏平均 F1 分数分别达到 0.956、0.813、0.492 和 0.457。两种 LLM 评审配置都表明，加入 few-shot 示例能够提高机制解释质量，但较强的结局预测并不总能确保恢复已记录的通路。我们的结果表明，受 AOP 启发的 LLM 有潜力支持 DNT 评估：它们可以将预测的神经发育结局与合理的生物学机制联系起来，并使预测能够在结局层面和通路层面同时接受评价。
items.author_line: Fan, Y., Xiao, S., Gao, F.

items.title: QMzyme: A Python Package for Automated and Systematic QM-based Enzyme Modeling
items.abstract_or_text: We introduce QMzyme, a Python package to automate the generation of Quantum mechanics (QM)-based enzyme models. QM calculations on enzymes are computationally challenging because full enzyme systems typically contain thousands of atoms, placing accurate QM treatments beyond practical computational limits.Therefore, QM-based enzyme studies rely on identifying a subset of atoms that captures the essential chemistry of the reaction environment, enabling tractable yet chemically meaningful calculations. However, constructing these reduced models requires numerous user-defined decisions, including selection of the starting structure, identification of atoms to include in the QM region, and definition of truncation strategies for QM-only models, all of which can substantially influence the resulting calculations. QMzyme aims to provide the community with a flexible and extensible framework for automated, systematic generation of QM-based enzyme models, enabling researchers to more rigorously evaluate how model construction decisions influence computational outcomes while improving reproducibility and transparency across workflows. By facilitating high-throughput generation and analysis of QM enzyme models, QMzyme supports largescale, data-driven investigations of enzyme structure, function, and reactivity. This effort is especially crucial for the creation of large, chemically consistent datasets that can support emergent artificial intelligence and machine learning approaches for accelerated digital discovery in enzymology and biocatalysis.
items.summary_zh: 推出 Python 包 QMzyme，自动化生成和系统比较基于 QM 的酶模型，显式管理起始结构、QM 区域和截断策略等建模选择。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 降低酶 QM 建模中人为决策和复现成本，并为构建化学一致的大规模酶量子化学数据集提供基础。摘要未报告与现有工具的定量对比或具体反应案例性能。
items.abstract_zh: 我们介绍 QMzyme，这是一个用于自动生成基于量子力学（QM）的酶模型的 Python 包。对酶进行 QM 计算具有挑战性，因为完整酶体系通常包含数千个原子，使得精确 QM 处理超出实际计算能力。因此，基于 QM 的酶研究依赖于识别能够捕捉反应环境关键化学信息的原子子集，从而实现可处理且具有化学意义的计算。然而，构建这些缩减模型需要大量由用户决定的选择，包括起始结构的选取、纳入 QM 区域的原子识别，以及仅 QM 模型的截断策略定义；所有这些选择都可能显著影响计算结果。QMzyme 旨在为社区提供一个灵活且可扩展的框架，用于自动、系统地生成基于 QM 的酶模型，使研究人员能够更严格地评估模型构建决策如何影响计算结果，同时提高整个工作流的可复现性和透明度。通过促进 QM 酶模型的高通量生成与分析，QMzyme 支持对酶结构、功能和反应性开展大规模、数据驱动的研究。对于创建能够支持新兴人工智能和机器学习方法、加速酶学与生物催化数字发现的大型化学一致数据集，这项工作尤其重要。
items.author_line: Arkanil Roy, Young Woo Kim, Heidi Klem

items.title: MOSAIC: Learning Graph Node Embeddings from Spectrally Isolated Dominant Subspaces of Accumulated Diffusion Operators
items.abstract_or_text: Biomedical knowledge graphs can connect information across genes, phenotypes, tissues, pathways, experiments, and clinical resources, but they are difficult to query correctly without detailed knowledge of the graph. Large language models can help write Cypher code for knowledge graphs, yet a query focused on a bioinformatics task that looks reasonable may still use the wrong identifier, relationship direction, source, intermediate node, or output unit if the user is not completely trained on the schema We developed ddkg.skill, an Agent Skill that can be loaded into a compatible LLM session to support querying of the NIH Common Fund Data Ecosystem Data Distillery Knowledge Graph (DDKG), a biomedical property graph integrating more than 180 ontologies, over 40 genomics datasets, and dozens of additional cross-domain biomedical datasets. Rather than utilizing a simple markdown prompt, ddkg.skill contains a controller, a compositional library of DDKG-specific references and structured tables, primary documentation, validated query patterns, a routing table, and a Python script that checks the internal links among these materials. The skill build for the December 2025 DDKG release contains 38 bundled files and 239 routing relationships and is identified by checksum so users can state the exact build used to compose a query. The evaluation reported here was performed separately on an earlier build with 38 files and 227 routing entries. In that orthogonal nine-test evaluation against a live December 2025 DDKG instance, five of seven tests targeting sources absent from the worked examples produced correct executed results. The evaluation also exposed a failed query, a cross-source comparison that was not biologically well posed, and errors in the skill's own reference material that informed later revisions. The skill guides an AI through entity resolution, graph inspection, query construction, and validation for biomedical and bioinformatics queries, while keeping the DDKG itself as the source of returned results. This design provides a portable and versioned method for giving general-purpose AI systems practical knowledge of a complex biomedical knowledge graph to empower complex bioinformatics data integration. Three executed biomedical use cases further demonstrate cross-species phenotype-to-expression querying, genomic overlap between 4DN chromatin-loop anchors and GTEx eQTLs, and integration of congenital heart phenotype associations with ClinVar and GTEx heart evidence.
items.summary_zh: 提出可版本化的 ddkg.skill，帮助大语言模型可靠查询整合 NIH DDKG 生物医学知识图谱。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把实体解析、图谱检查、查询构造和验证流程结构化，并以可复现实验揭示技能包的有效性与局限。
items.abstract_zh: 生物医学知识图谱可以连接基因、表型、组织、通路、实验和临床资源中的信息，但如果不熟悉图谱的详细模式，就很难正确查询。大语言模型可以帮助编写知识图谱的 Cypher 代码，但如果用户没有接受完整培训，一个看似合理、聚焦生物信息学任务的查询仍可能使用错误的标识符、关系方向、来源、中间节点或输出单位。我们开发了 ddkg.skill，这是一种可加载到兼容 LLM 会话中的 Agent Skill，用于支持对 NIH Common Fund Data Ecosystem Data Distillery Knowledge Graph（DDKG）的查询。DDKG 是一个生物医学属性图谱，整合了 180 多个本体、40 多个基因组数据集以及数十个其他跨领域生物医学数据集。ddkg.skill 不采用简单的 markdown 提示，而是包含控制器、DDKG 专用参考资料和结构化表格、主要文档、经过验证的查询模式、路由表，以及用于检查这些材料内部链接的 Python 脚本。2025 年 12 月 DDKG 发布版的 skill 构建包含 38 个捆绑文件和 239 条路由关系，并通过校验和标识，因此用户可以声明用于组合查询的确切构建版本。本研究报告的评估在更早的构建版本上单独完成，该版本包含 38 个文件和 227 条路由关系。在一个实时的 2025 年 12 月 DDKG 实例上进行的正交九项测试中，针对示例中未出现来源的七项测试有五项产生了正确的执行结果。评估还暴露出一次失败查询、一个生物学上定义不恰当的跨来源比较，以及 skill 自身参考材料中的错误，这些发现推动了后续修订。该 skill 引导 AI 完成实体解析、图谱检查、查询构造和验证，同时将 DDKG 本身保留为结果来源。这种设计为通用 AI 系统提供了一种可移植、可版本化的方法，使其获得复杂生物医学知识图谱的实用知识，从而支持复杂的生物信息学数据整合。三个已执行的生物医学用例进一步展示了跨物种表型到表达的查询、4DN 染色质环锚点与 GTEx eQTL 的基因组重叠，以及先天性心脏表型关联与 ClinVar 和 GTEx 心脏证据的整合。

items.title: Spatial organization of CAF subtypes establishes a VCAN‑laden neurogenesis‑mimicry barrier driving immune exclusion and immunotherapy resistance in gastric cancer
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Immune checkpoint blockade only generates durable anti-tumor responses in a minor subset of gastric carcinoma patients; transcriptomic evidence indicates stromal fibroblast remodeling is the core driver of immunotherapeutic failure, yet no defined molecular cascade links extracellular matrix stiffening, neural-like cell reprogramming and poor treatment response. We integrated single-cell profiles, Visium spatial sequencing and bulk transcript datasets covering 757 gastric cancer patient specimens to characterize a fibroblast-restricted neurogenesis mimicry (NM) transcriptional program. Matrix-remodeling POSTN⁺/FAP⁺ and structural COL1A1⁺/COL1A2⁺ fibroblast subsets carried elevated NM module scores; CellChat ligand-receptor mapping proved laminin and CD99 signal cascades restructure intercellular communication within high-NM tissue microregions. Unsupervised clustering built upon the 136 fibroblast-specific NM signature separated all enrolled patients into three subgroups with divergent long-term survival trajectories. Ten independent survival prediction algorithms were benchmarked, and random survival forest (RSF) delivered optimal predictive power with an average C-index of 0.84, with stable performance recorded across eight fully independent validation cohorts. Reverse single-cell projection localized all bulk-derived prognostic risk signals to stromal fibroblast and endothelial cell populations. SHAP interpretable modeling paired with scTenifoldKnk single-gene virtual knockout identified a ten-gene functional module centered on VCAN; these genes exclusively expressed in high-NM fibroblasts and correlated with epithelial-mesenchymal transition, invasive phenotypes and angiogenic activity. After adjusting age, gender and pathological stage covariates, continuous RSF risk scores retained independent prognostic capacity. High-risk lesions recorded elevated TIDE values and M2 macrophage enrichment, consistent with an immune-excluded cold tumor phenotype. Visium spatial mapping localized NM fibroblast hotspots adjacent to disordered microvessels and dense fibrotic stromal borders. Cell-free biophysical binding assays (SPR/BLI) paired with in vivo orthotopic syngeneic models validated the dual oncogenic effects of NM-high fibroblasts: VCAN-rich extracellular matrix forms physical barriers to trap cytotoxic CD8⁺ T cells, while paracrine VCAN directly binds Integrin β1 to activate AKT/ERK signaling, inducing neuron-like transdifferentiation and accelerating gastric carcinoma progression. Multi-dimensional profiling infers fibroblast-dependent neurogenesis mimicry acts as a druggable stromal driver for gastric cancer progression and immunotherapy resistance, with VCAN-laden matrix walls representing a precise therapeutic target to reverse immune exclusion.

items.abstract_zh: 摘要：免疫检查点阻断仅能在少数胃癌患者中产生持久的抗肿瘤反应；转录组证据表明，基质成纤维细胞重塑是免疫治疗失败的核心驱动因素，但尚无明确的分子级联将细胞外基质硬化、神经样细胞重编程和治疗反应不佳联系起来。我们整合单细胞图谱、Visium 空间测序和 bulk 转录组数据，覆盖 757 份胃癌患者样本，以刻画成纤维细胞限制性的神经发生模拟（NM）转录程序。基质重塑型 POSTN⁺/FAP⁺ 和结构型 COL1A1⁺/COL1A2⁺ 成纤维细胞亚群具有较高的 NM 模块评分；CellChat 配体—受体映射证明，laminin 和 CD99 信号级联会重塑高 NM 组织微区中的细胞间通信。基于 136 基因成纤维细胞特异性 NM 特征的无监督聚类，将所有纳入患者分为三个长期生存轨迹不同的亚组。我们比较了 10 种独立生存预测算法，随机生存森林（RSF）取得最佳预测能力，平均 C-index 为 0.84，并在 8 个完全独立的验证队列中保持稳定性能。反向单细胞投影将所有源自 bulk 的预后风险信号定位到基质成纤维细胞和内皮细胞群。SHAP 可解释建模结合 scTenifoldKnk 单基因虚拟敲除，识别出以 VCAN 为中心的十基因功能模块；这些基因仅在高 NM 成纤维细胞中表达，并与上皮—间质转化、侵袭表型和血管生成活性相关。在校正年龄、性别和病理分期协变量后，连续 RSF 风险评分仍保留独立的预后能力。高风险病灶具有较高的 TIDE 值和 M2 巨噬细胞富集，与免疫排斥型冷肿瘤表型一致。Visium 空间定位显示，NM 成纤维细胞热点邻近紊乱的微血管和致密的纤维化基质边界。细胞游离生物物理结合实验（SPR/BLI）结合体内原位同基因移植模型，验证了 NM 高表达成纤维细胞的双重致癌效应：富含 VCAN 的细胞外基质形成物理屏障，捕获细胞毒性 CD8⁺ T 细胞；旁分泌 VCAN 直接结合 Integrin β1，激活 AKT/ERK 信号，诱导神经样转分化并加速胃癌进展。多维度分析推断，成纤维细胞依赖的神经发生模拟可能是胃癌进展和免疫治疗耐药的可药物作用基质驱动因素，而富含 VCAN 的基质壁可能是逆转免疫排斥的精准治疗靶点。

items.title: @pushmeet：Today, our team is sharing a preprint on our new system for generative de-novo enzyme design, AlphaProtein Novo. At @Goo
items.abstract_or_text: Today, our team is sharing a preprint on our new system for generative de-novo enzyme design, AlphaProtein Novo. At @GoogleDeepMind, we have long focused on the building blocks of life (proteins). We developed AlphaFold to predict structure, trained language models to understand function, and built AlphaProteo to design de-novo binders. But proteins play many important roles in nature, such as enzymes that catalyze chemical reactions. Designing entirely new enzymes from scratch to catalyze custom reactions has long been a holy grail for scientists. Our team has shown how AlphaProtein Novo can produce new-to-nature enzymes with state-of-the-art activity on 2 benchmark reactions. We’ve also designed custom enzymes to synthesize the pharmaceutical motif piperidine, and others to degrade the environmental plasticizer toxin DEHP. While there is much more work to do in this direction, we’re excited to have demonstrated the ability to design functional proteins that go beyond what is known in nature. Huge congratulations to @jueseph, @ZvxyWu, Josh Abramson, the @GoogleDeepMind protein design team, and our collaborators in the @francesarnold & Liu Group! 🎉 🔗 Preprints and code: https://t.co/tGklluPQFC https://t.co/2YGfFVzC9H
items.summary_zh: Pushmeet Kohli 分享 AlphaProtein Novo 预印本：该系统用于从头设计新酶，在两个基准反应上取得当前最先进的活性，并设计出可合成哌啶药用结构、降解环境增塑剂 DEHP 的酶。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是具有明确实验验证和应用目标的蛋白质生成设计发布。编辑判断：相比泛泛的模型宣传，该帖给出了基准反应和具体化学/环境任务，信息密度较高。
items.abstract_zh: 今天，我们团队分享一种用于生成式从头酶设计的新系统 AlphaProtein Novo 的预印本。在 Google DeepMind，我们长期专注于生命的基本构件——蛋白质。我们开发了 AlphaFold 来预测结构，训练语言模型来理解功能，并构建了 AlphaProteo 来设计从头结合蛋白。但蛋白质在自然界中还承担许多重要作用，例如催化化学反应的酶。从头设计能够催化定制反应的全新酶，一直是科学家长期追求的目标。我们的团队已经证明，AlphaProtein Novo 能够生成自然界中不存在的新酶，并在两个基准反应上取得当前最先进的活性。我们还设计了用于合成药物哌啶结构的定制酶，以及用于降解环境增塑剂毒物 DEHP 的其他酶。虽然这一方向还有很多工作要做，但我们很高兴已经展示出设计超越自然界已知范围的功能蛋白的能力。祝贺 Jue Wang、Zvxy Wu、Josh Abramson、Google DeepMind 蛋白质设计团队，以及 Frances Arnold 团队和 Liu 团队的合作者！预印本和代码：链接见原帖。

items.abstract_or_text: Watermarks have limits. They’re often undetectable, especially in short passages. Rewriting or translating text can completely remove the watermark. That’s why, for now, only approved researchers will have access to our detector, so they can help us evaluate and improve the technology. We’re treating text watermarking as an ongoing area of research. We’ll keep testing and improving, with feedback from users, developers, policymakers, and researchers.

items.abstract_zh: 水印存在局限。在短文本中，水印往往无法被检测到；改写或翻译文本也可能完全去除水印。因此，目前检测器只会向获批研究者开放，让他们帮助我们评估和改进这项技术。我们把文本水印视为一个持续研究的领域。我们将继续测试和改进，并听取用户、开发者、政策制定者和研究人员的反馈。

items.title: DeMiR: Density-Matrix-Informed Representations for Molecular Property Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: The Hohenberg–Kohn theorem, which states that all physical quantities in the ground state are functionals of the electron density, suggests that much of a molecule's behavior is encoded in its electronic structure. This study proposes DeMiR, a model that treats electron density matrix prediction as a pretraining task. DeMiR reconstructs cc-pVDZ/B3LYP density matrices for molecules ranging in size from QM9-scale molecules to drug-like molecules with up to 146 atoms, achieving median NMAE values of 1.0% and 2.16%, respectively. At the atomic level, the model's embeddings contain electronic structure information: per-atom electronic observables are predicted with an R² of 0.94 by a linear probe, whereas Uni-Mol reaches 0.84 and a randomly initialized model of the same architecture only 0.63. The embeddings also remove 44.9% of the residual error left by a geometry-based descriptor, showing that this information is not linearly accessible from an explicit geometric descriptor. At the molecular level, transfer depends on the label type. Where electronic structure directly determines the property, transfer holds: on an external experimental pKa test set, fine-tuned DeMiR achieves an MAE of 1.143, significantly outperforming a randomly initialized control with the same architecture and training budget (1.397), and performing on par with or better than chemical foundation models pretrained on far larger datasets. In contrast, for labels such as pIC50 and ADMET, DeMiR shows no consistent advantage over existing general-purpose foundation models, as two-dimensional substructures and physicochemical descriptors have already saturated predictive performance. This study presents the scope within which a connection between electron density prediction capability and molecular property prediction capability holds, along with its boundaries.
items.summary_zh: 提出以电子密度矩阵重建为预训练任务的 DeMiR，用其嵌入编码电子结构信息，并在 pKa 预测上优于同架构随机初始化模型，但对 pIC50 和 ADMET 未显示一致优势。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 明确检验了“电子密度表征能否迁移到分子性质预测”这一关键假设，同时报告了有效范围和边界。需要注意的是，优势主要出现在电子结构直接决定的性质，不能泛化为所有药物性质任务。
items.abstract_zh: Hohenberg–Kohn 定理指出，基态的所有物理量都是电子密度的泛函，这意味着分子的许多行为都编码在其电子结构中。本研究提出 DeMiR，将电子密度矩阵预测作为预训练任务。DeMiR 重建了从 QM9 规模分子到最多含 146 个原子的类药分子的 cc-pVDZ/B3LYP 密度矩阵，其对应的中位数 NMAE 分别为 1.0% 和 2.16%。在原子层面，模型嵌入包含电子结构信息：线性探针对原子电子观测量的预测 R2 达到 0.94，而 Uni-Mol 达到 0.84，同一架构的随机初始化模型仅为 0.63。嵌入还消除了几何描述符留下的 44.9% 残余误差，表明这些信息无法通过显式几何描述符线性获得。在分子层面，迁移效果取决于标签类型。对于电子结构直接决定的性质，迁移有效：在外部实验 pKa 测试集上，微调后的 DeMiR 达到 1.143 的 MAE，显著优于采用相同架构、训练预算的随机初始化对照模型（1.397），并达到或优于在规模大得多的数据集上预训练的化学基础模型。相反，对于 pIC50 和 ADMET 等标签，DeMiR 相较现有通用基础模型没有显示一致优势，因为二维子结构和物理化学描述符的预测性能已经趋于饱和。本研究展示了电子密度预测能力与分子性质预测能力之间联系成立的范围及其边界。

items.title: Resolving Kinase Resistance Landscapes via Antisymmetric Siamese Graph Networks and Co-Folding Ensembles
items.abstract_or_text: Acquired clinical resistance to small-molecule kinase inhibitors arising from single-point mutations within the ATP-binding cleft presents a critical challenge in precision oncology. Conventional computational modeling relies either on rigid docking—which overlooks induced structural alterations—or computationally demanding alchemical free energy perturbation (FEP) methods that cannot scale across wide mutational panels. In this work, we present an end-to-end computational methodology integrating multi-state conformational ensemble generation via the generative biomolecular co-folding engine Boltz with a continuous distance-aware Siamese Graph Neural Network (GNN). Crucially, we introduce an unconstrained bias-free difference head that strictly enforces thermodynamic antisymmetry (f (0) ≡ 0.0 kcal/mol), eliminating trivial baseline drift. Under rigorous 5-fold cross-validation on experimentally characterized kinase resistance pairs, the model achieves an out-of-fold root-mean-square error (RMSE) of 1.637 kcal/mol (MAE = 1.459 kcal/mol, Pearson R = 0.239, Spearman ρ = 0.260). Across a prospective panel of 52 clinical kinase-inhibitor complexes, the architecture structurally rationalizes key resistance patterns, resolving the steric disruption of the ABL1 T315I gatekeeper mutation circumvented by ponatinib and the covalent ablation of EGFR C797S against osimertinib.
items.summary_zh: 将 Boltz 生成的多状态构象集合与反对称 Siamese GNN 结合，预测激酶抑制剂突变导致的耐药差异，并对 52 个临床复合物进行前瞻性结构解释。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 针对刚性对接不可处理诱导构象变化、FEP 难以扩展的问题，提出可扩展的端到端方案，并能解释 ABL1 T315I–ponatinib 与 EGFR C797S–osimertinib 案例。主要限制是 Pearson R=0.239、Spearman ρ=0.260，相关性仍然有限。
items.abstract_zh: 小分子激酶抑制剂因 ATP 结合裂隙中的单点突变而产生的获得性临床耐药，是精准肿瘤学面临的关键挑战。传统计算建模要么依赖刚性对接——忽略诱导的结构变化——要么依赖计算成本高昂、无法扩展到大规模突变面板的炼金术自由能微扰（FEP）方法。在本研究中，我们提出一种端到端计算方法，将通过生成式生物分子协同折叠引擎 Boltz 生成的多状态构象集合，与连续的、距离感知的 Siamese 图神经网络（GNN）相结合。关键是，我们引入了一个无约束、无偏差的差分头，严格施加热力学反对称性（f(0) ≈ 0.0 kcal/mol），从而消除平凡的基线漂移。在具有实验表征的激酶耐药配对上进行严格的 5 折交叉验证时，该模型达到离折根均方误差（RMSE）1.637 kcal/mol（MAE = 1.459 kcal/mol，Pearson R = 0.239，Spearman ρ = 0.260）。在包含 52 个临床激酶–抑制剂复合物的前瞻性面板上，该架构从结构上解释了关键耐药模式，包括 ABL1 T315I 看门人突变造成的空间位阻如何被 ponatinib 绕过，以及 EGFR C797S 如何使 osimertinib 的共价作用失效。
items.author_line: Sharif Ahmad Naikoo

items.title: Protein Language Model-Boosted Prediction of Isoelectric Point
items.abstract_or_text: pH plays a key role in many biological processes. When the solution pH equals the isoelectric point (pI) of a protein, the protein carries zero net charge, which minimizes its solubility and thus promotes aggregation. Here we present ESMpI, a sequence-based protein pI predictor that combines optimized pKa values of seven ionizable residue types and two terminals with embeddings from a pre-trained protein language model. Benchmarked against experimental protein pI values, ESMpI outperforms other state-of-the-art methods, including structure-based approaches that derive the pI of a protein from residue-specific pKa calculations. Finally, ESMpI requires only sequence information, making it well suited for high-throughput proteomescale analyses and protein engineering.
items.summary_zh: 提出仅依赖序列的 ESMpI，将七类可电离残基与两个末端的优化 pKa 和蛋白质语言模型嵌入结合，用于高通量预测蛋白等电点。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在不需要结构输入的前提下优于多种现有方法，适合蛋白质组规模分析和蛋白工程。限制是摘要未给出数据集规模、具体误差和跨物种泛化结果。
items.abstract_zh: pH 在许多生物过程中发挥关键作用。当溶液 pH 等于蛋白质的等电点（pI）时，蛋白质携带的净电荷为零，其溶解度最低，从而促进聚集。在此，我们提出 ESMpI，一种基于序列的蛋白质 pI 预测器，将七类可电离残基和两个末端的优化 pKa 值与预训练蛋白质语言模型的嵌入相结合。以实验蛋白质 pI 值为基准测试时，ESMpI 优于其他最先进方法，包括根据残基特异性 pKa 计算、从蛋白质结构推导 pI 的结构方法。最后，ESMpI 只需要序列信息，因此适合高通量蛋白质组规模分析和蛋白质工程。
items.author_line: Fangfang Luo, Xiangxiang Lu, Zhitao Cai, Hongyu Lin, Yandong Huang

items.title: Cohort-scale Spatial Host-Microbiome Predicts Post-Resection Recurrence in Colorectal Cancer
items.abstract_or_text: The tumor microenvironment in colorectal cancer (CRC) is a heterogeneous ecosystem in which host cells and microbial communities interact dynamically, influencing disease progression. However, the clinical utility is limited by the lack of a scalable spatial host-microbiome technique and by insufficient integration of artificial intelligence for the interpretation of high-dimensional multi-omics data. To overcome the barriers, we present AlphaFISH, a platform technology integrating both technical and computational innovations for multi-omics spatial analysis of clinical biopsies at subcellular resolution. The system uses a sequencing-free, high-throughput, spatial profiling technique to construct, to date, the largest clinical spatial transcriptomics and spatial microbiome datasets acquired from 149 colorectal biopsies from 68 human subjects, supported by a comprehensive scRNA-seq atlas covering 4.27 million cells across 650 patients for robust cell annotation. Deep learning of the cohort-scale dual-omics data, consisting of more than 10 million subcellular sampling vectors, enables the development of a transformer model with joint embeddings of gene expression, spatial architecture, and the microbial microenvironment in colon tissues, achieving nearly 90% accuracy in predicting CRC-associated pathological features using unseen spatial omics inputs. The AI interrogation further predicts tumour recurrence at 81% accuracy in 28 patients followed within 1 year post tumor resection period. AlphaFISH reveals that spatial interactions between Fusobacterium and cellular niche consisting of tumor and T cells serve as key markers of CRC malignancy, progression, and recurrence, indicating the critical role of spatial bacterial-immune crosstalks.
items.summary_zh: AlphaFISH 将亚细胞空间宿主—微生物组学与深度学习结合，用于结直肠癌病理特征和术后复发预测。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究整合149例活检、4.27百万细胞图谱和超过1000万空间采样向量，展示了大规模临床空间多组学的转化潜力。
items.abstract_zh: 结直肠癌（CRC）的肿瘤微环境是一个异质性生态系统，其中宿主细胞与微生物群落动态相互作用，影响疾病进展。然而，由于缺乏可扩展的空间宿主—微生物组技术，以及对高维多组学数据的人工智能解释整合不足，其临床实用性受到限制。为克服这些障碍，我们提出 AlphaFISH，这是一种整合技术和计算创新、用于在亚细胞分辨率下分析临床活检多组学空间信息的平台技术。该系统采用无需测序的高通量空间分析技术，构建了截至目前规模最大的临床空间转录组和空间微生物组数据集，数据来自 68 名受试者的 149 份结直肠活检样本；同时以覆盖 650 名患者、包含 4.27 million 个细胞的综合 scRNA-seq 图谱支持稳健的细胞注释。对队列规模双组学数据进行深度学习，这些数据包含超过 10 million 个亚细胞采样向量，构建了一个联合嵌入基因表达、空间结构和结肠组织微生物微环境的 transformer 模型。该模型在未见过的空间组学输入上预测 CRC 相关病理特征的准确率接近 90%。AI 分析进一步在肿瘤切除术后 1 年内随访的 28 名患者中，以 81% 的准确率预测肿瘤复发。AlphaFISH 显示，Fusobacterium 与由肿瘤细胞和 T 细胞组成的细胞生态位之间的空间相互作用，是 CRC 恶性程度、进展和复发的重要标志，提示空间细菌—免疫串扰具有关键作用。

items.title: Explainable machine learning identifies predictors for postural instability and cognitive impairment in early Parkinsons Disease
items.abstract_or_text: Parkinsons disease (PD) exhibits considerable variability in symptom onset, severity, and clinical trajectories, making prediction of individual disease progression a complex challenge. Leveraging large multimodal datasets from two independent cohorts of early PD patients, we examined predictive features for progression to mild cognitive impairment (MCI) and postural instability (PI) using Explainable Boosting Machines (EBM) - an interpretable machine learning (ML) approach. We found comparable predictive performances of EBM models using a minimal clinico-demographic dataset compared to an extended multimodal dataset including volumetric brain imaging and fluid biomarkers. Baseline age and Montreal Cognitive Assessment total score were identified as most important predictive features for both MCI and PI using the minimal dataset, while additional motor, cognitive and imaging features were identified using the extended dataset. Our study highlights the potential of ML predictions of cognitive and motor endpoints of PD progression at the individual level bringing personalized clinical decision-making within reach.
items.summary_zh: 在两个独立早期 Parkinsons disease 队列中，用可解释 boosting 模型识别轻度认知障碍和姿势不稳的进展预测因子。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结果显示简化的临床人口学数据与扩展多模态数据表现相近，为评估个体化预测的增量价值提供了依据。
items.abstract_zh: Parkinsons disease（PD）在症状出现、严重程度和临床轨迹方面存在显著差异，因此预测个体疾病进展是一项复杂挑战。我们利用两个独立的早期 PD 患者大型多模态数据集，采用可解释 boosting machine（EBM）这一可解释机器学习方法，研究进展为轻度认知障碍（MCI）和姿势不稳（PI）的预测特征。我们发现，与包含脑容量成像和体液生物标志物的扩展多模态数据集相比，仅使用最小临床—人口学数据集的 EBM 模型也取得了相近的预测性能。在最小数据集中，基线年龄和 Montreal Cognitive Assessment 总分被确定为预测 MCI 和 PI 最重要的特征；在扩展数据集中，还识别出其他运动、认知和成像特征。本研究强调，机器学习有望在个体层面预测 PD 的认知和运动终点，使个体化临床决策更接近实际应用。

items.title: Three Cerebellar Imaging Subtypes in Schizophrenia with Distinct Spatiotemporal Trajectories and Biological Characteristics
items.abstract_or_text: The potential role of the cerebellum in the pathophysiology of schizophrenia (SCZ) has received relatively insufficient attention. Prior studies characterized cerebellar abnormalities mainly at the group level, without fully considering the heterogeneity of the disease. Here, we applied a machine learning approach (Subtype and Stage Inference, SuStaIn) to cross-sectional 3D volumetric MRIs of the cerebellum, including 1,588 individuals with SCZ (638 females; mean age: 31.9 +/- 12.0 years) and 2,341 healthy controls (HC) (1,041 females; mean age: 33.3 +/- 13.6 years), from 17 sites worldwide. SuStaIn identified three distinct spatiotemporal trajectories in cerebellar gray matter volume (GMV) reduction, respectively originating in lobule X (subtype 1), lobule III (subtype 2) and lobule VIIb (subtype 3), with subtypes 1 and 3 corresponding to the posterior lobe and subtype 2 to the anterior lobe. These cross-sectionally inferred trajectories were replicated in two independent samples of 1,334 and 530 patients, respectively. Multimodal analyses using neuroimaging, transcriptomic and behavioral data revealed subtype-specific biological characteristics in brain morphological patterns, cerebellar-cortical connectivity, gene expression and clinical symptoms. Specifically, subtype-related genes were enriched in metabolism-related processes and immunity-related processes, respectively, in subtype 1 and subtype 2; subtype 3 showed more severe brain abnormalities and worse cognitive symptoms. Treatment data from 381 patients, with up to 12 months of follow-up, revealed poorer response to antipsychotic medications (APM) in subtype 2 and subtype 3, but better response to transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) in subtype 1, which also had worse emotion-related symptoms. Together, our findings offer a comprehensive characterization of the heterogeneity of cerebellar pathophysiological progresses in SCZ, which may help in developing future clinical stratification and targeted intervention strategies.
items.summary_zh: 基于17个站点的3D 小脑 MRI，SuStaIn 识别出三种精神分裂症小脑灰质体积时空轨迹，并在独立样本中复现。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将影像、转录组、行为和治疗随访关联到亚型，提示分层研究方向，但横断面轨迹仍不等同于个体纵向因果进程。
items.abstract_zh: 小脑在精神分裂症（SCZ）病理生理学中的潜在作用此前受到的关注相对不足。既往研究主要在群体层面描述小脑异常，没有充分考虑疾病的异质性。在本研究中，我们将机器学习方法 Subtype and Stage Inference（SuStaIn）应用于小脑横断面 3D 体积 MRI，样本包括来自全球 17 个站点的 1,588 名 SCZ 个体（638 名女性；平均年龄 31.9 +/- 12.0 岁）和 2,341 名健康对照（HC）（1,041 名女性；平均年龄 33.3 +/- 13.6 岁）。SuStaIn 识别出三种不同的小脑灰质体积（GMV）减少时空轨迹，分别起始于 X 小叶（亚型 1）、III 小叶（亚型 2）和 VIIb 小叶（亚型 3）；亚型 1 和 3 对应后叶，亚型 2 对应前叶。这些基于横断面推断的轨迹在两个独立样本中得到复现，样本量分别为 1,334 和 530 名患者。利用神经影像、转录组和行为数据进行的多模态分析揭示了亚型特异性的脑形态模式、小脑—皮层连接、基因表达和临床症状生物学特征。具体而言，亚型相关基因分别在代谢相关过程和免疫相关过程中富集于亚型 1 和亚型 2；亚型 3 表现出更严重的脑异常和更差的认知症状。来自 381 名患者、最长 12 个月随访的治疗数据显示，亚型 2 和亚型 3 对抗精神病药物（APM）的反应较差，而亚型 1 对经颅磁刺激（TMS）的反应较好；亚型 1 同时具有更严重的情绪相关症状。总体而言，本研究全面刻画了 SCZ 小脑病理生理进程的异质性，可能有助于未来制定临床分层和靶向干预策略。

items.title: Patterns of GLP-1 Receptor Agonist Initiation Compared With Other Glucose-Lowering and Anti-Obesity Therapies Among Older Adults
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) have rapidly expanded from primarily glucose-lowering agents for type 2 diabetes (T2D) to therapies used across diabetes, obesity, and cardiometabolic disease. Prescribing has risen sharply since 2018, especially with the broader uptake of semaglutide-based products. Still, real-world initiation patterns remain incompletely characterized in older adults with varying levels of cognitive vulnerability and frailty. Methods: We analyzed treatment patterns of GLP-1RA use in a retrospective cohort of adults aged >=65 years with T2D in a regional healthcare system from 2018 to 2026. We describe the demographic and clinical characteristics of new initiators of GLP-1RAs compared with initiators of alternative therapies, including sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors (SGLT2i) and dipeptidyl peptidase-4 inhibitors (DPP-4i). We analyzed a sub-cohort of patients to identify the prevalence of baseline cognitive concerns using a large language model (LLM). We used a LASSO logistic regression to identify important predictors of GLP-1RA initiation compared to other therapies. Results: Of 58,754 adults aged 65 years or older with T2D, 5,095 initiated GLP-1RA, 5,483 initiated a SGLT2 inhibitor, and 1,516 initiated a DPP-4 inhibitor. GLP-1RA initiators were younger (mean 75.2 [SD 4.9] vs 77.7 [6.0] and 79.5 [7.1] years) and less often aged 80 years or older (17.7% vs 35.0% and 47.6%). The largest difference across groups was adiposity: mean BMI was 33.8 (6.2) vs 29.7 (5.7) and 28.6 (5.6) kg/m2 (SMD 0.592), with a BMI of 30 kg/m2 or higher in 72.1% vs 41.9% and 34.0%. Glycemic control was similar (mean HbA1c 7.46% vs 7.38% and 7.70%; SMD 0.165). GLP-1RA initiators were younger; more likely to be overweight; had lower average comorbidity index; and less dementia, heart failure, and renal disease than those initiating alternative therapies. GLP-1RA initiators had fewer hospitalizations 1-year prior to drug initiation. In a LASSO model, BMI greater than 27 kg/m2 was the strongest predictor of GLP-1RA initiation (positive), followed by baseline congestive heart failure (negative) and baseline hospitalization (negative). Conclusion: In this cohort of older adults, those with T2D who initiated GLP-1RAs were younger and had less comorbidities at baseline compared to initiators of other T2D therapies. Overweight BMI was the strongest predictor of GLP-1RAs initiation, whereas baseline HbA1c was similar across groups, suggesting that the decision to start GLP1-RA is more influenced by adiposity than glycemic control. Our analysis of real-world prescribing patterns appear to be in alignment with guidelines for Type II diabetes treatment1, which recommend GLP-1RA treatment for glucose lowering and weight management and SGLT2 treatment in those with risk of cardiovascular disease or heart failure.
items.summary_zh: 回顾性分析58754名老年 T2D 患者的 GLP-1RA 启动模式，发现 BMI 而非 HbA1c 是最强预测因素。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 大样本真实世界比较揭示了老年患者中 GLP-1RA 与替代药物启动者的基线差异，但不能据此推断治疗效果或因果关系。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：胰高血糖素样肽-1 受体激动剂（GLP-1RAs）已从主要用于降低血糖的 2 型糖尿病（T2D）药物，迅速扩展为用于糖尿病、肥胖和心脏代谢疾病的治疗。自 2018 年以来，处方量快速上升，尤其是在基于 semaglutide 的产品更广泛采用之后。然而，对于认知脆弱性和衰弱程度不同的老年人，真实世界的启动模式仍未得到充分刻画。方法：我们分析了一个区域医疗系统中年龄 >=65 岁、患有 T2D 的成年人在 2018 至 2026 年间使用 GLP-1RA 的治疗模式。我们描述 GLP-1RA 新启动者与其他替代治疗新启动者的​​人口学和临床特征，替代治疗包括钠—葡萄糖协同转运蛋白-2 抑制剂（SGLT2i）和二肽基肽酶-4 抑制剂（DPP-4i）。我们分析一个亚队列，使用大语言模型（LLM）识别基线认知问题的患病率。我们使用 LASSO logistic 回归，识别相对于其他治疗而言 GLP-1RA 启动的重要预测因子。结果：在 58,754 名年龄 65 岁或以上的成年人中，5,095 人启动 GLP-1RA，5,483 人启动 SGLT2 抑制剂，1,516 人启动 DPP-4 抑制剂。GLP-1RA 启动者更年轻（平均 75.2 [SD 4.9] 岁，对比 77.7 [6.0] 岁和 79.5 [7.1] 岁），年龄达到 80 岁或以上的比例也更低（17.7%，对比 35.0% 和 47.6%）。各组间最大的差异是肥胖程度：平均 BMI 为 33.8 (6.2)，对比 29.7 (5.7) 和 28.6 (5.6) kg/m2；BMI 为 30 kg/m2 或以上的比例为 72.1%，对比 41.9% 和 34.0%。血糖控制相近（平均 HbA1c 为 7.46%，对比 7.38% 和 7.70%；SMD 0.165）。GLP-1RA 启动者更年轻、更可能超重，平均合并症指数更低，痴呆、心力衰竭和肾脏疾病更少。GLP-1RA 启动者在用药启动前 1 年内的住院次数更少。在 LASSO 模型中，BMI 大于 27 kg/m2 是 GLP-1RA 启动最强的正向预测因子，其次是基线充血性心力衰竭和基线住院，两者均为负向预测因子。结论：在该老年人队列中，与启动其他 T2D 治疗者相比，启动 GLP-1RA 的患者更年轻，基线合并症更少。超重 BMI 是 GLP-1RA 启动的最强预测因素，而基线 HbA1c 相近，提示启动 GLP-1RA 的决策更多受肥胖程度影响，而非血糖控制。我们的真实世界处方模式分析似乎与 II 型糖尿病治疗指南一致：指南建议 GLP-1RA 用于降低血糖和体重管理，并建议心血管疾病或心力衰竭风险患者使用 SGLT2 治疗。

items.title: Pervasive Backdoor Vulnerabilities in Genomic Foundation Models
items.abstract_or_text: Genomic foundation models are revolutionizing biological research and biotechnology, yet their vulnerability to data poisoning remains poorly characterized. Here we show that backdoor attacks can be reliably implanted during fine-tuning across diverse model architectures, tasks and model scales by poisoning only a small fraction of training data with short DNA motifs, including triggers derived from transposon terminal inverted repeats (TIRs). Attack success rates are generally high across encoder-based and autoregressive models, while clean-task performance remains almost unchanged. Increasing model scale does not confer measurable resistance. To detect such threats, we develop a two-stage auditing framework that flags potentially poisoned sequences through localized single-nucleotide mutation sensitivity in model predictions, without prior knowledge of trigger sequences. These results identify downstream fine-tuning as an attack surface for genomic foundation models and motivate stronger data provenance, adversarial evaluation and post-training security auditing.
items.summary_zh: 系统评估基因组 foundation model 在微量 DNA 投毒下的后门攻击，并提出无需预先知道触发序列的两阶段审计框架。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结果显示模型规模未带来可测量的抵抗力，强调训练数据来源、对抗评估和 post-training 安全审计的必要性。
items.abstract_zh: 基因组 foundation model 正在推动生物学研究和生物技术发展，但其对数据投毒的脆弱性仍缺乏充分刻画。我们显示，在不同模型架构、任务和模型规模中，只需在训练数据中加入少量含有短 DNA motif 的投毒样本（包括源自转座子末端反向重复序列（TIR）的触发序列），就可以在微调期间可靠植入后门攻击。基于编码器和自回归的模型通常都具有较高的攻击成功率，而干净任务性能几乎不变。增加模型规模并未带来可测量的抵抗力。为检测这类威胁，我们开发了一个两阶段审计框架，通过模型预测对局部单核苷酸突变的敏感性来标记可能被投毒的序列，而无需预先知道触发序列。这些结果表明，下游微调是基因组 foundation model 的一个攻击面，并提示需要更严格的数据来源追踪、对抗性评估和训练后安全审计。
items.author_line: Ni, S., Wang, Q., Wei, C., Ni, X., Li, S., Zhao, Z., Li, H., Ji, R., Xu, R., Alinejad-Rokny, H., Wang, T., Yang, M.

items.title: Planner-Executor Style Multimodal Agentic System to Answer Patient Questions in Lung Cancer Screening CT
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Accurate patient understanding of lung cancer screening (LCS) results is critical for engagement and follow-up adherence, given the currently low screening uptake. While artificial intelligence (AI) systems show promise in facilitating patient communication, its effective use in clinical settings requires appropriate invocation of imaging tools and self-regulation by deferring certain questions to physicians. To this end, we developed and evaluated a planner-executor style multimodal agentic system to answer simulated patient questions about LCS CT results. Methods: This retrospective study utilized 116 LCS CT reports and images collected from a tertiary academic hospital. The system employed a multi-agent architecture (planner and executor) to mimic clinical reasoning. We developed a large language model (LLM)-based question generation framework to prepare a comprehensive set of 699 simulated patient questions, categorized as answerable and defer-to-doctor to assess self-regulation. Performance was evaluated on tool-calling, self-regulation accuracy (ability to correctly defer out-of-scope questions to a human provider) assessed by LLM-as-a-judge, and clinical quality assessed by a reader performance study with four physicians evaluating a subset of 100 responses. Results: The system demonstrated high overall tool-calling accuracy of 93.1% (646/694; 95% CI: 91.2%, 95.0%) and self-regulation accuracy of 92.6% (462/499; 90.2%, 94.8%). For answerable questions, the percentage of responses receiving perfect 5.0 scores across all readers included 78.9% (180/228) for clinical accuracy (inter-rater agreement: Gwet's AC2=0.92), and 73.2% (167/228) for patient understandability (0.86). For defer-to-doctor questions, the percentage of responses included 77.3% (133/172) for clinical accuracy (0.80) and 70.3% (121/172) for patient understandability (0.78). Conclusions: The planner-executor style multi-modal agentic system reliably answers patient-specific questions about LCS. Its high tool-calling and self-regulation performance demonstrates its potential as a safe and effective digital communication facilitator in LCS programs.
items.summary_zh: 构建 planner-executor 多模态智能体回答肺癌筛查 CT 患者问题，并评估工具调用、自我约束和临床可读性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在116份 CT 报告/影像和699个模拟问题上，系统同时量化了回答能力与应转诊问题的自我限制。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：准确理解肺癌筛查（LCS）结果对于提高参与度和后续随访依从性至关重要，因为当前筛查参与率较低。人工智能（AI）系统有望促进患者沟通，但要在临床环境中有效使用，必须适当调用影像工具，并通过将某些问题交由医生回答来实现自我约束。为此，我们开发并评估了一个 planner-executor 风格的多模态智能体系统，用于回答有关 LCS CT 结果的模拟患者问题。方法：本回顾性研究使用了来自一家三级学术医院的 116 份 LCS CT 报告和影像。系统采用多智能体架构，由 planner 和 executor 组成，以模拟临床推理。我们开发了一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的问题生成框架，构建了 699 个模拟患者问题，并将其分为可回答问题和应转交医生的问题，以评估自我约束能力。评估指标包括工具调用、由 LLM-as-a-judge 评估的自我约束准确率（正确将超出范围的问题转交给人工医务人员的能力），以及临床质量；临床质量通过 4 名医生对部分 100 条回答进行阅评来评估。结果：系统总体工具调用准确率为 93.1%（646/694；95% CI 91.2%–95.0%），自我约束准确率为 92.6%（462/499；90.2%–94.8%）。对于可回答问题，在所有阅评者评分均为满分 5.0 的回答中，临床准确性占 78.9%（180/228；评阅者间一致性 Gwet's AC2=0.92），患者可理解性占 73.2%（167/228；0.86）。对于应转交医生的问题，相应比例分别为临床准确性 77.3%（133/172；0.80）和患者可理解性 70.3%（121/172；0.78）。结论：该 planner-executor 风格多模态智能体系统能够可靠地回答关于 LCS 的患者个体化问题。其较高的工具调用和自我约束表现显示出在 LCS 项目中作为安全、有效的数字沟通促进工具的潜力。

items.title: Mining the cysteine-motif repertoire of airway mucins reveals redox-active mucolytic peptides
items.abstract_or_text: Muco-obstructive lung diseases are characterized by hyper concentrated airway mucus in which gel-forming mucins form mechanically reinforced polymer networks. Thiol-based mucolytics can reduce disulfide bonds within these networks, but clinically used monothiols show limited potency, whereas stronger reducing agents are constrained by instability and toxicity. Here, we systematically mined the major airway mucins MUC5B and MUC5AC for closely spaced cysteine motifs and screened the resulting mucin-derived peptide library for redox activity, oxidation stability, solubility, epithelial compatibility, and mucolytic activity. The identified Cys–[X]n–Cys peptides displayed pronounced sequence- and pH-dependent thioldisulfide exchange capabilities, with many peptides reacting faster than monothiol controls and several exhibiting reactivity approaching or superior to dithiothreitol (DTT). Reactivity was governed by the combined effects of thiol number, apparent thiol pKa, and local motif architecture rather than by a single physicochemical descriptor. Analysis of free-thiol stability and oxidation products further revealed sequence-dependent access to distinct intra- and intermolecular disulfide states. Together, these measurements provide a systematic sequence-redox framework for understanding how closely spaced cysteine motifs tune thioldisulfide exchange, with implications for the design of redox-active peptides and for understanding how local cysteine sequence environments may contribute to oxidative protein folding. Developability profiling identified soluble, reduced-thiol-stable, and epithelialcompatible candidates. Selected peptides reduced high-molecular-weight MUC5B multimers in cystic fibrosis mucus and MUC5AC multimers in asthma mucus, with activities in the range of DTT and greater than NAC under the tested conditions. These peptides were active in both pathological and healthy mucus, while showing compound-dependent differences in their concentration-response profiles across mucus environments. Our findings point at airway mucins as a source of redox-active peptide candidates with potential for mucolytic therapy and provide a broadly applicable resource for relating cysteine-motif sequence to disulfideexchange behavior.
items.summary_zh: 系统挖掘气道黏蛋白 MUC5B 和 MUC5AC 的邻近半胱氨酸基序，筛得具有硫醇–二硫键交换活性的黏液溶解肽，并在囊性纤维化和哮喘黏液中验证其作用。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作将序列基序、氧化还原化学、可开发性和黏液溶解活性串联起来，发现部分肽的活性达到 DTT 水平并高于 NAC。限制在于摘要只报告体外黏液体系结果，尚不能推断体内疗效或安全性。
items.abstract_zh: 黏液阻塞性肺病的特征是气道黏液高度浓缩，其中形成凝胶的黏蛋白构成机械增强的聚合物网络。基于硫醇的黏液溶解剂可以还原这些网络中的二硫键，但临床使用的单硫醇效力有限，而更强的还原剂又受到稳定性和毒性的限制。在本研究中，我们系统挖掘主要气道黏蛋白 MUC5B 和 MUC5AC 中彼此接近的半胱氨酸基序，并对由黏蛋白衍生的肽库进行氧化还原活性、氧化稳定性、溶解性、上皮相容性和黏液溶解活性筛选。所鉴定的 Cys–C[X]n–Cys 肽表现出显著的、依赖序列和 pH 的硫醇–二硫键交换能力；许多肽的反应速度快于单硫醇对照，另有数种肽的反应性接近或优于二硫苏糖醇（DTT）。反应性由硫醇数量、表观硫醇 pKa 和局部基序结构的综合作用决定，而不是由单一物理化学描述符决定。对游离硫醇稳定性和氧化产物的分析进一步显示，不同序列对不同分子内和分子间二硫键状态的可达性不同。这些测量结果建立了一个系统的序列–氧化还原框架，用于理解邻近半胱氨酸基序如何调节硫醇–二硫键交换，并为设计氧化还原活性肽以及理解局部半胱氨酸序列环境如何参与氧化折叠提供启示。可开发性分析鉴定出具有溶解性、还原态硫醇稳定性和上皮相容性的候选肽。选定的肽能够在囊性纤维化黏液中降低高分子量 MUC5B 多聚体，并在哮喘黏液中降低 MUC5AC 多聚体；在测试条件下，其活性处于 DTT 范围内并高于 NAC。这些肽在病理性和健康黏液中均有活性，但在不同黏液环境中的浓度–反应曲线存在依赖化合物的差异。我们的研究表明，气道黏蛋白可以作为具有潜在黏液溶解治疗价值的氧化还原活性肽候选来源，并提供了一个可广泛应用的资源，用于关联半胱氨酸基序序列与二硫键交换行为。

items.title: From Computation-Ready to Claim-Ready: An Evidence Framework for MOF Machine Learning
items.abstract_or_text: Scientific data are routinely transformed so they can be stored, joined and used by machine-learning models. These steps enable scale, but they can also remove the context that tells us what a prediction means and how far it can be trusted. Metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) make this problem especially clear: one nominal material may appear as an experimental crystal, an activated simulation structure, a charge-assigned model or a row of descriptors, while information about protonation, counterions, coordination environment or measurement conditions may disappear along the way. We introduce claim readiness: a framework for asking whether the evidence preserved through a data pipeline is sufficient for the scientific claim made at the end of it. By tracing chemical evidence, identifier joins and evaluation choices, we show that data can be highly usable for machine learning yet incomplete for chemistry-sensitive interpretation, and that a model can still be useful for ranking candidates even when its value-level accuracy decreases under a harder split. The wider lesson is not specific to MOFs: trustworthy scientific machine learning requires a traceable connection between the representation used by the model and the evidence needed to support the resulting claim. Highlights • Claim readiness matches scientific claims to evidence preserved in data pipelines • Model-ready materials data can lose chemistry needed for interpretation • Data joins change which materials enter representation comparisons • Harder data splits reduce accuracy while useful candidate ranking can remain
items.summary_zh: 提出“主张就绪度”框架，追踪 MOF 数据管线中的化学证据、标识符连接和评估选择，判断模型输出是否足以支持最终科学主张。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 直接回应材料机器学习中结构表示、数据拼接和测量条件丢失导致的可解释性与可信度问题，并提醒困难数据划分下数值准确率下降时排序仍可能有用。其价值主要是方法论框架，摘要没有给出广泛外部验证。
items.abstract_zh: 科学数据通常会经过转换，以便存储、连接和供机器学习模型使用。这些步骤有助于扩大规模，但也可能移除能够说明预测含义及其可信范围的上下文。金属–有机框架（MOF）尤其清楚地体现了这一问题：同一种名义材料可能表现为实验晶体、活化模拟结构、赋予电荷的模型或一行描述符，而质子化状态、反离子、配位环境或测量条件等信息可能在转换过程中消失。我们提出“主张就绪度”（claim readiness），用来判断数据管线中保留下来的证据是否足以支持最终提出的科学主张。通过追踪化学证据、标识符连接和评估选择，我们表明，数据对于机器学习可能高度可用，但对于化学敏感的解释却可能不完整；即使在更困难的数据划分下，数值层面的准确率下降，模型仍可能适合对候选物进行排序。更广泛的启示并不局限于 MOF：可信的科学机器学习需要在模型使用的表征与支撑所得主张所需的证据之间建立可追溯联系。要点：主张就绪度将科学主张与数据管线中保留的证据相匹配；适合模型的数据可能丢失解释化学现象所需的化学信息；数据连接会改变进入表征比较的材料；更困难的数据划分会降低准确率，但候选排序的有效性可能仍然保留。
items.author_line: Natalia Lydia Papadantonaki, Shayan Abaei, Joshua Emptoz, Mehrdad Asgari

items.title: Construction of a Prognostic Model for Pancreatic Cancer Based on mitochondrial dynamics-Related Genes: Application of Multiple Machine Learning Methods
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Purpose To investigate the prognostic significance of mitochondrial dynamics-related genes in pancreatic adenocarcinoma (PAAD) and determine whether a machine learning-derived signature could predict patient survival, tumor microenvironment characteristics, and therapeutic response. Methods Transcriptomic and clinical data from TCGA-PAAD and normal pancreatic tissues from GTEx were analyzed to identify differentially expressed mitochondrial dynamics-related genes. Multiple machine learning algorithms were applied to construct a prognostic model, which was externally validated using ICGC and GEO cohorts. Survival, Cox regression, functional enrichment, somatic mutation, immune infiltration, and drug sensitivity analyses were performed. Single-cell RNA sequencing and spatial transcriptomics were used to characterize the cellular and spatial distributions of the core genes. Results Thirty-two prognostic mitochondrial dynamics-related genes were identified, of which seven genes—ALDH3A1, CD36, CKB, FOXM1, IGF2BP3, INS, and MET—were selected for the final signature. The resulting risk score effectively stratified patients into groups with significantly different survival outcomes and remained an independent prognostic factor after adjustment for clinicopathological variables. High-risk tumors were associated with cancer progression, cell-cycle and motility pathways, immunosuppressive features, distinct somatic mutations, and reduced sensitivity to several chemotherapeutic agents. Single-cell analysis localized multiple signature genes predominantly to ductal epithelial cells, while spatial analysis showed increasing MET expression during malignant progression. Conclusion The seven-gene mitochondrial dynamics signature provides a potential tool for prognostic stratification and therapeutic-response prediction in PAAD. Prospective clinical validation and functional experiments are required before clinical application.
items.summary_zh: 基于 TCGA、GTEx、ICGC、GEO 及单细胞和空间转录组数据构建胰腺癌线粒体动力学七基因预后特征。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 外部队列验证和多组学定位提高了模型可信度，但作者明确指出仍需前瞻性临床验证和功能实验。
items.abstract_zh: 目的：研究线粒体动力学相关基因在胰腺腺癌（PAAD）中的预后意义，并确定机器学习衍生的特征是否能够预测患者生存、肿瘤微环境特征和治疗反应。方法：分析 TCGA-PAAD 的转录组和临床数据，以及 GTEx 的正常胰腺组织数据，以识别差异表达的线粒体动力学相关基因。应用多种机器学习算法构建预后模型，并使用 ICGC 和 GEO 队列进行外部验证。开展生存分析、Cox 回归、功能富集、体细胞突变、免疫浸润和药物敏感性分析。利用单细胞 RNA 测序和空间转录组学刻画核心基因的细胞和空间分布。结果：鉴定出 32 个具有预后意义的线粒体动力学相关基因，其中 ALDH3A1、CD36、CKB、FOXM1、IGF2BP3、INS 和 MET 七个基因被选入最终特征。所得风险评分有效地将患者分为生存结局显著不同的组；在校正临床病理变量后，风险评分仍是独立预后因素。高风险肿瘤与癌症进展、细胞周期和细胞运动通路、免疫抑制特征、不同的体细胞突变以及对若干化疗药物敏感性降低相关。单细胞分析显示，多个特征基因主要定位于导管上皮细胞；空间分析显示，MET 表达随恶性进展而增加。结论：这七基因线粒体动力学特征为 PAAD 的预后分层和治疗反应预测提供了潜在工具。在临床应用前仍需开展前瞻性临床验证和功能实验。
items.author_line: Gongping M, Yuchuan L, Shu Q

items.title: Explainable machine learning estimates clinically significant prostate cancer risk in men with PSA 4–20 ng/mL
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Men with prostate-specific antigen (PSA) values of 4–20 ng/mL often have overlapping risks of benign disease, clinically insignificant prostate cancer, and clinically significant prostate cancer (csPCa). We retrospectively studied 859 men who underwent pathological evaluation; 76 had csPCa. Twelve prediction algorithms were assessed with 500 bootstrap resamples. In every resample, LASSO feature selection, hyperparameter tuning, and model fitting used only the bootstrap training sample, and performance was estimated from patient-level out-of-bag predictions. C5.0 had the highest AUROC point estimate (0.843, 95% CI 0.801–0.886), an AUPRC of 0.421, and a Brier score of 0.066. Calibration was broadly concordant at low-to-moderate predicted risks but uncertain in the sparse high-risk tail. At a 0.10 risk threshold, the model would avoid 544.8 biopsies per 1,000 men while missing 10.5 csPCa cases per 1,000. PSA-derived measures supplied most of the linear predictive signal, whereas the clearest additional gain arose with nonlinear integration. C5.0 may support pre-biopsy triage, but multicenter external validation, recalibration assessment, and prospective impact studies are required before clinical use.
items.summary_zh: 在 PSA 4–20 ng/mL 的859名男性中比较12种算法，评估可解释模型对临床显著性前列腺癌风险的估计。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 采用 bootstrap 训练内特征选择和患者级 out-of-bag 评估，量化了活检减少与漏诊之间的权衡，并明确需要多中心前瞻性验证。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要：前列腺特异性抗原（PSA）值为 4–20 ng/mL 的男性，常同时存在良性疾病、临床无意义前列腺癌和临床显著性前列腺癌（csPCa）的重叠风险。我们回顾性研究了 859 名接受病理学评估的男性，其中 76 人患有 csPCa。使用 500 次 bootstrap 重采样评估 12 种预测算法。在每次重采样中，LASSO 特征选择、超参数调优和模型拟合仅使用 bootstrap 训练样本完成，性能则由患者级 out-of-bag 预测估计。C5.0 的 AUROC 点估计最高，为 0.843（95% CI 0.801–0.886）；AUPRC 为 0.421，Brier 分数为 0.066。在低到中等预测风险范围内，校准总体一致，但高风险尾部因样本稀疏而不确定。在 0.10 风险阈值下，该模型每 1,000 名男性可避免 544.8 次活检，同时漏掉 10.5 例 csPCa。PSA 衍生指标提供了大部分线性预测信号，而最明显的额外增益来自非线性整合。C5.0 可能支持活检前分诊，但在临床使用前仍需多中心外部验证、重新校准评估和前瞻性影响研究。
items.author_line: Xie S, Wang Q, Wang X, Jiang X, Gao H, Luo Y, Fan L, Li Q, Wang H, Cai X, Zhou W, Wu T

items.title: Longitudinal linear-epitope profiling of SLE identifies novel antigens associated with disease and disease activity
items.abstract_or_text: Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) is the prototypical systemic autoimmune disease defined by the production of autoantibodies directed against diverse self-antigens. Antinuclear antibodies (ANA) are central to SLE diagnosis, and anti-double-stranded DNA (anti-dsDNA) antibodies are clinically used to track disease activity. However, these biomarkers provide only partial insight into the full spectrum of autoimmune changes in patients. To expand the known landscape of SLE autoreactivity shared among patients and associated with disease activity, we performed an unbiased characterization of 1,268 SLE plasma samples from 695 SLE patients and 301 healthy controls using phage immunoprecipitation and sequencing (PhIP-seq). This technique preferentially displays linear epitopes, and thus provides a complementary set of autoreactivities to previously discovered autoreactive targets. Despite the marked clinical heterogeneity of SLE, machine learning applied to this data surfaced a shared, reproducible signature that robustly discriminates between SLE and healthy controls in two validation cohorts. Autoreactivities in SLE were significantly enriched for RNA-binding protein targets. Autoreactive proteins containing Basic Acidic Dipeptides (BAD) repeat domains, features associated with biomolecular condensate formation, distinguished patients with high disease activity (by SLEDAI score) from patients with no disease activity. Among all shared autoreactivities, a peptide derived from YTHDF2 emerged as the most prevalent target across SLE cohorts occurring in ~25% of SLE patients and displayed striking sequence similarity to a peptide derived from the Epstein Barr virus (EBV) lytic switch protein BZLF1. Competition assays demonstrated higher-affinity binding to the viral peptide, supporting a model in which antiviral humoral responses to EBV may drive secondary epitope spreading toward molecularly mimicked self-antigens. Remarkably, orthogonal validation using the Luminex bead platform containing a panel of only 10 peptides, including BZLF1, demonstrated strong discrimination between SLE and healthy controls (AUC = 0.95). Together, these findings identify a rich, greatly expanded landscape of autoreactivities in SLE, candidate biomarkers associated with high disease activity, and provide mechanistic insight linking EBV-driven immunity to epitope-specific autoimmunity in lupus.

items.why_it_matters_zh: YTHDF2/BZLF1 分子模拟线索和10肽 Luminex 验证将大规模筛选连接到可检验的自身免疫机制假说。
items.abstract_zh: 系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）是典型的系统性自身免疫病，其特征是产生针对多种自身抗原的自身抗体。抗核抗体（ANA）是 SLE 诊断的核心，抗双链 DNA（anti-dsDNA）抗体则用于临床追踪疾病活动度。然而，这些生物标志物只能部分反映患者自身免疫变化的完整谱系。为扩展已知的、在患者之间共享并与疾病活动度相关的 SLE 自身反应性图谱，我们使用噬菌体免疫沉淀与测序（PhIP-seq），对来自 695 名 SLE 患者的 1,268 份血浆样本和 301 名健康对照进行了无偏表征。该技术优先展示线性表位，因此能够为此前发现的自身反应性靶标提供互补信息。尽管疾病具有显著的临床异质性，对这些数据应用机器学习后，得到一个共享且可重复的特征，在两个验证队列中均能稳健地区分 SLE 与健康对照。SLE 的自身反应性显著富集于 RNA-binding protein 靶标。含有 Basic Acidic Dipeptides（BAD）重复结构域的自身反应性蛋白具有与生物分子凝聚体形成相关的特征，能够区分 SLEDAI 评分所定义的高疾病活动度患者与无疾病活动度患者。在所有共享的自身反应性中，源自 YTHDF2 的肽成为各 SLE 队列中最常见的靶标，约出现在 25% 的 SLE 患者中；该肽与 Epstein Barr virus（EBV）裂解开关蛋白 BZLF1 的一段肽表现出显著的序列相似性。竞争实验显示，抗体对病毒肽的结合亲和力更高，这支持一种模型：针对 EBV 的抗病毒体液免疫反应可能通过分子模拟，驱动继发性表位扩展至自身抗原。值得注意的是，使用仅含 10 条肽（包括 BZLF1）的 Luminex 微球平台进行正交验证，能够强力区分 SLE 与健康对照（AUC = 0.95）。综上，这些发现确定了 SLE 中大幅扩展的自身反应性图谱、与高疾病活动度相关的候选生物标志物，并提供了将 EBV 驱动的免疫反应与狼疮中表位特异性自身免疫联系起来的机制线索。
